sn34.46:1.2: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo.
sn34.46:1.3: samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo.
sn34.46:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo.
sn34.46:1.5: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca.
sn34.46:1.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati
sn34.46:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ …pe…
